༄༅/ /bla ma dgongs 'dus spyi dril gyi sgrub pa las bsdus pa nor bu'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bla ma dgongs 'dus spyi dril gyi sgrub pa las bsdus pa nor bu'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī ye// bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa las thams cad spyi dril gyi sgrub pa yid bzhin nor bu las cung zad bsdus te lam 'dir mos pa rnams kyi nyams len rgyun 'khyer du bya ba la/ dbang thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas nyams su blang bya ni/ mnyam par bzhag pa dang*/ ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po bskyed rim dang*/ rdzogs rim mo// dang po la'ang gnyis| sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi'o// dang po ni/ stan bde bar sman raka gtor mchod rdor dril rnams 'du byas shing*/ gtso bo dgu'i bris sku yod na'ang mdun du bkram/ kha lho nub tu phyogs pas/ rgyun 'khyer la sman raka gtor mchod bris sku yod na legs shing ma 'dzom na'ang mi dgos/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma spro na bya zhing*/ sman raka gtor mchod yod na byin gyis brlabs/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rtsa ba gsum sgrub par sems bskyed la/ bdag nyid padma 'byung gnas su gsal ba'i snying nang du padma dmar po'i steng du sems 'od gsal rang bzhin nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gzung 'dzin dang bral ba'i hrīḥyig dmar po'i 'od kyi rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dkyil 'khor dgu'i lha tshogs bla ma 'od dpag med kyi rnam pas gtso bo'i dbu brgyan pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ zhes| shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ rtsa gsum gyi bstod pa gang rung gis bstod la/ yan lag bdun pa dang rtsa gsum gyi skyabs 'gro bya/ de'i ngang nas skyabs yul dang sems can rdzas la sogs pa thams cad rang bzhin ma grub pa chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med pa de bzhin nyid dang*/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad snying rje'i yul du sems pa kun snang dang*/ de rnams kyi don du rdzogs byang bsgrub pa'i blo bskyed pa rgyu'i ting 'dzin gsum rang rgyud la 'dre nges gsal btab/

tshad med bzhi sgom zhing*/ oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā dzñā na swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med par gyur par bsam pa ni tshogs gnyis bsags pa'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la pho brang lha bskyed pa'o// dang po ni/ stong pa'i ngang las bsrung ba'i gur khang yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ phyi nas rim bzhin me ri 'od lnga rdo rje padma'i ra ba'i nang du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su/ baṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho rab tu 'khyil ba'i dbus su/ paṃ las padma'i sdong po yal ga lo 'dab me tog 'bras bu rgyas pa'i snying por bhrūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang rtse mo lnga pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing 'od kyi tshang tshing rab tu 'khrigs pa'i dbus su padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa mu khyud dang bcas pa'i lte bar ze'u 'bru dmar ser ge sar mngon par lhag pa la/ nyi zla dang phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi 'dab ma brgyad pa la'ang nyi zla'i gdan re re bsam/ gnyis pa lha bskyed pa la bzhi/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis rlabs pa/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dgug gzhug /dbang bskur ba rnams so/ */dang po dam tshig pa bskyed pa ni/ gdan dbus ma'i steng mtshan so gnyis kyi ngo bo/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ phrag gnyis mu tig gi phreng ba lta bu zhu ba las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba lta bu'i me long lta bu'i ye shes dang*/ de'i steng du dpe byad brgyad cu'i ngo bo/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ da tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣaḥ ya ra la wa da dha/ phrag gnyis padma rā ga'i phreng ba lta bu zhu ba las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ gdan nyi zla la byang chub pa/ nyi zla kha sbyor gyi bar du rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo hrīḥlas padma dmar po hrīḥs gsung yig 'bru la byang chub pa/

mtshan pa dang*/ maṃ las bdud rtsi'i bum pa maṃ gyis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa thugs phyag mtshan la byang chub pa/ lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dang*/ aḥlas dril bu yu ba aḥs mtshan par bsal ba ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ de ltar nyi zla phyag mtshan yig 'bru dang bcas pa dbyer med du 'dres pa ni bya ba nan tan ye shes/ stong pa nyid la byang chub pa/ de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid gtso mchog padma badzra rtsal zhal gsum/ g.yas sngo g.yon dkar/ rtsa zhal dang sku mdog dmar po/ zhal re re la'ang spyan gsum gsum pa/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs shing bzhad pa'i tshul can/ smin mtshams su khro gnyer bsdus pa| smin ma dang ag tshom dmar ser gyen du 'phyo ba/ dbu skra nag pa dbu gtsug tu bcings pa'i lhag ma thur du grol ba'i steng du rin po che dbang gi rgyal pos spras pa'i rtse mor rigs bdag 'od dpag tu med pas mtshan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ bar pa gnyis kyis ral gri dang thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ tha ma gnyis bdud rtsi'i bum pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang rin po che'i zar bu dar sna tshogs kyi cod pan can/ sku stod la glang chen gyi pags pa/ smad la stag gi sham thabs/ sked pa la zhing gi g.yang gzhi/ phyag zhabs sbrul gyis 'khyud pa/ thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal dang skam po lnga bcu'i dbu brgyan la rin po che'i rtse bran gyi lte bar sangs rgyas rigs lngas mtshan pa/ zhal la rakta'i thig le/ rtsib logs la thal chen gyi tshom bu/ mkhur tshos la zhag gi zo ris kyis spras pa/ gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan zhing 'od dmar ba'i dkyil du zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum gyis gdug byed pho mo brdzis pa'i pang du yum gsang ba ye shes dbyings kyi ḍā ki manda ra ba dmar mo/ g.yas ḍā ru yab la 'khyud cing 'khrol ba/

g.yon dung dmar stob pa/ spyan gsum zlum 'khyil yab la gzigs shing*/ zhal 'dzum mdangs kyis gtso bo dang zhal sbyor ba/ gzhon tshul lang tsho dang ldan pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang dar dpyangs rin po che dur khrod kyi chas rnams kyis brgyan pa yab yum gnyis gzi brjid kyi nyams dang ldan pa/ sku yongs su rdzogs pa sku yongs la byang chub pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so// de nas mkha' gsang byin brlab ni/ yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs pa las padma 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru āḥs mtshan pa/ yab kyi gsang ba rdo rje rtse lnga pa sngon po'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ yum gyis yab la oṃ padma su kha dha ra ma hā rā ga su kha dha ra tsa tur ā nanda bha ga bi shwa hūm̐ hūm̐ karmaṃ ku ru ṣyā mi/ zhes bskul bas/ yab kyis oṃ ma hā de wa tsa tur ā nanda dā ya ka kha ga /mu khe ka ra so nā tha hūm̐ hūm̐ karmaṃ ku ru ṣyā mi/ zhes lan byin nas/ yab yum rdo rje dang padma rgyas par mdzad de/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ ra ho haṃ rā ga yā mi/ zhes snyoms 'jug gi brdas bskul te yab yum phan tshun bsrubs pa dang bsrub pa'i 'khrul 'khor mdzad de bde ba g.yo ba na/ haṃ ha si si su kha su kha dha ri ku ru ku ru ku ru ṣyā mi ku ru badzra dhṛka /ces pa'i bde ba'i sgras/ sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes chags mes 'od du zhu ba thig le'i tshul du rdo rje'i lam nas bab/ yum gyi bha gar 'khyil ba 'od zer dang lhan cig par phyir 'phros| dum bu brgyad du gyur nas phyogs mtshams kyi gnas so sor 'khod pa yongs su gyur pa las/ shar gyi 'dab mar 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa las buddha thod phreng rtsal/ g.yas sngo g.yon dmar/ rtsa zhal dang sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas gsum 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ zhing dbyug /g.yon gsum bdud rtsi'i bum pa/

dril bu/ zhags dmar bsnams pa'i pang du/ rdo rje dbyings phyug ma khro 'dzum nam mkha'i mdog can/ g.yas rin po che'i rgyal mtshan bsnams pas yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yon dung phor bdud rtsis bkang ba stob pa/ lho'i 'dab mar rin po che'i rgyan ser po trāṃ gis mtshan pa las mi bskyod rdo rje/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ rtsa zhal dang sku mdog ser po/ g.yas gsum ral gri/ mdung thung*/ thod dbyug /g.yon gsum steng gi 'jig rten ye shes kyi me dang srid pa'i rlung bsnams pa'i pang du/ yum bde ba'i dbyings phyug ma dmar ser khro 'dzum/ g.yas chos 'byung bsnams nas yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yon dung dmar stob pa/ nub kyi 'dab mar padma dmar po hrīḥs mtshan pa las padma dbang chen rtsal/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon mthing*/ rtsa zhal dang sku mdog dmar po/ g.yas gsum mu tig dmar po'i phreng ba/ rnga yab/ lcags kyu/ g.yon gsum padma 'dab drug /padma rā ga'i ga'u bdud rtsis gang ba/ zhags dmar bsnams pa'i pang du/ yum lha mo rig byed ma dmar skya/ g.yas gser gyi ḍā ma ru bsnams nas yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yon thod khrag stob pa/ byang gi 'dab mar rdo rje rgya gram ljang gu āḥs mtshan pa las rig 'dzin thod pa rtsal/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ dbus zhal dang sku mdog ljang gu/ g.yas gsum rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ ral gri/ g.yon gsum dril bu/ sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa rdo rje'i zhags pa/ srid pa'i phur bu bsnams pa'i pang du/ yum mkha' 'gro nyi zla'i thod phreng ma dmar mo/ g.yas thod rlon gyi phreng ba 'dren pas yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yon nyi zla'i ga'u 'dzin pa/ shar lho'i 'dab mar gser gyi mchod rten gyi bum par hūm̐ dmar po'i mtshan pa las drag po rtsal me'i phreng ba can/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon ljang*/ rtsa zhal dang sku mdog dmar la rngam pa/ g.yas gsum gnam lcags kyi rdo rje/ lcags kyi tho lum/ bskal pa'i me/ g.yon gsum thod khrag /lcags sdig nag po/

bgegs kyi rū pa bsnams pa'i pang du/ yum khams gsum srid pa'i bdag mo dmar nag lcags kyi ral pa can/ g.yas khro chu'i tho ba bsnams nas yab la 'khyud pa/ g.yon dung dmar stob pa/ lho nub kyi 'dab mar gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag gis mtshan pa las sangs rgyas dpa' bo thod pa'i dum bu/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ rtsa zhal dang sku mdog mthing nag /g.yas gsum 'khor lo/ zla ba/ me thab/ g.yon gsum thong gshol/ nyi ma/ rlung nag bsnams pa'i pang du/ yum sangs rgyas dpa' mo dkar mo/ g.yas srid pa'i 'khor lo bsnams pas yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yon thod khrag stob pa/ nub byang gi 'dab mar be con hrīḥdamar pos mtshan pa las dpal rta mgrin/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon sngo/ rtsa zhal dang sku mdog dmar po/ dbu gsum gyi gtsug tu rta mgo ljang zhur rngog ma le brgan can re res mtshan pa/ g.yas gsum rdo rje/ kha ṭwāṃ/ sbrul zhags/ g.yon gsum thod khrag /dril bu/ lcags sgrog bsnams pa'i pang du/ yum e ka tsā ti smug nag /g.yas tri shūl 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yon dung khrag stob pa/ byang shar gyi 'dab ma la rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte ba hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa las dpal phyag na rdo rje/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ zhal dang sku gdog mthing nag /g.yas gsum rdo rje/ gri gug /sbrul zhags/ g.yon gsum dril bu/ thod khrag /padma bsnams pa'i pang du/ yum gsang ba dbyings phyug ma dmar mo/ g.yas kha ṭwāṃ dang bcas pas yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yon bhan dmar stob pa/ de ltar gsal ba'i yab rnams rgyan cha lugs thams cad gtso bo yab dang mthun zhing rab tu khros pa/ yum rnams kyang cha lugs gtso mo yum dang mthun zhing*/ khro 'dzum gyi mdangs can yab kyi zhal dang sbyor ba yab yum thams cad rang 'od 'khrigs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de nas gtso bo yab yub snyoms par zhugs pa'i rjes chags kyi bde ba chen po'i mes 'od du zhu nas gdan gyi steng du bde ba chen po'i ngo bo byang chub sems kyi thig le gcig tu gyur pa'i tshe/

rigs kyi lha mo bzhis tshad med pa bzhi'i zhu ba'i glus bskul ba'i tshe/ bcom ldan 'das sngon gyi smon lam rjes su dran pas/ thig le de nyid dum bu gsum du gyur pa'i steng gi thig le ā di zla ba dang*/ 'og gi thig le kā di las nyi ma dang*/ bar gyi thig le phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa rnams gcig tu 'dres pa las/ gtso bo chen po 'bras bu'i he ru kar bzhengs pa ni gtso mchog padma badzra rtsal/ zhal gsum g.yas sngo zhes pa nas/ gzi brjid kyi nyams dang ldan pa zhes pa'i bar gyi gong bzhin gsal gdab bo// de nas gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su hrīḥdamar po/ yum gyi thugs kar baṃ dmar po/ gtso bo brgyad kyi thugs kar rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa rnams las 'od 'phros/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang dang*/ nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad rtsa ba gsum gyi rang bzhin snang la ma grub pa chu zla ltar gyur par bsam/ gnyis pa sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gtso bo la sogs pa yab rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ las sku'i ḍā ki ma dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung gi ḍā ki ma dmar mo/ thugs kar hūm̐ las thugs kyi ḍā ki ma mthing ga /de gsum ga'ang g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod khrag /mchan khung g.yon du kha ṭwāṃ ga thogs pa/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar can rus pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ yum rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje dkar po/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje dmar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje mthing kha rnams phyag gnyis rdor dril bsnol zhing skyil krung gis bzhugs pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras pa'o// gsum pa ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug ni/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs bskyed pa lta bu las sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/

hūm̐ hrīḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bla med rdzas// gzugs sgra la sogs dngos por snang dang gzhan// khu ba bde chen tshim zhing rnam rol ba// dam tshig ye shes dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul// gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sarba buddha bo dhi satwa ma hā pū dza hoḥ /byin rlabs kun 'byung bla ma rje// dngos grub ma lus 'byung ba'i lha// phrin las nyer sgrub ḍā ki'i tshogs// yon tan rmad byung e ma hoḥ /zhes brjod cing bstod la/ rang gi snying kha nas lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyi 'od zer mdun gyi ye shes pa rnams kyi thugs kar reg pa tsam gyis bkug par bsams la/ lcags kyu'i rgyas/ e hye hi bha ga wan ma hā kā ru ṇi ka gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa ma ya ā karṣa ya dzaḥ zhags pa'i rnam pa can gyi 'od zer mgrin par reg pas gzhal yas khang gi nang du byon par bsam zhing*/ zhags pa'i rgyas/ gong gi sngags mthar/ pri we sha ya hūm̐/ lcags sgrog gi rnam pa can gyi 'od zer phyag zhabs la reg pas dam tshig pa rnams la sib sib thim par bsam zhing*/ lcags sgrog gi rgyas/ gong gi sngags mthar/ bhandha baṃ/ dril bu'i rnam pa can gyi 'od zer mang pos mnyes par byas par bsam zhing*/ dril bu'i rgyas/ gong gi sngags mthar/ wa shyaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes dgug gzhug bcing mnyes par bya'o// bzhi pa dbang bskur ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis dbang lha rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ khro bo bcu/ lha mo drug dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ ye shes chen po'i dkyil 'khor mdzod// nyon mongs la sogs chags bral ba// dam tshig kun gyi de bzhin nyid// rdo rje can kun bdag nyid mdzod// ces bstod nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das// bdag nyid chen po thugs rje can// rigs rnams ma lus kun 'dus dpal// bdag la dbang bskur mdzad du gsol| |oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/

zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lngas rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams te/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa// dbang bskur mchog chen dam pa sbyin// oṃ sarba dharma saṃ bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bum pa spyi bor sbyin zhing blugs gtor mdzod/ dbang bskur/ yum bzhis/ oṃ badzra satwa su saṃ gra ha/ badzra ratna ma nutta raṃ/ badzra dharma kā ya naṃ/ badzra ātma ka rarbha we/ zhes rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis/ hrīḥ bkra shis gang yin sems can snying la gnas// 'gro rnams mchog gi rang bzhin dge gyur pa// skyed byed gyis bskyed bde 'byung ji lta ba// de ltar dbang bskur mchog gi bkra shis shog /ces shis pa brjod/ khro bo bcus/ oṃ āḥbighnānta kṛta badzra ma hā kro dha hūm̐/ yakṣa kro dha ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bgegs bskrad/ lha mo drug gis/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ nas/ shapad pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes mchod/ bum pa'i chus smin mtshams yan chad gang*| lus kyi dri ma dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ rgyan dang cha lugs kyi dag pa dran par bya/ mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ ngag gi dri ma dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob/ 'khor lo lnga yi dag pa dran par bya/ snying ga yan chad gang*/ yid kyi dri ma dag par bya/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ skye mched drug gi dag pa dran par bya/ rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag /dbang bzhi pa thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo yab yum la 'od dpag med dang*/ gzhan rnams la so so'i rigs kyi rgyal bas dbu brgyan par gyur par bsams la/ snod bcud rten dang brten pa'i rang bzhin du bsam pa'ang snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang nas gtso bor thams cad gsal snang ma thon gyi bar gsal btab cing rtse gcig tu bsgom/ gnyis pa rdzogs rim bsgom pa ni/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun bca'/

ngag smra bcad/ dbugs rang sor bzhag /yid rnam g.yeng spangs te/ rang lhar gsal ba'i spyi bo nas lte ba'i bar rtsa a wa dhū ti phra zhing gsal ba shel gyi sbu gu lta bu thig le'i dwangs mas gang ba/ de'i g.yas su ro ma me'i rang bzhin dmar po raktas gang ba/ g.yon du rkyang ma chu'i rang bzhin dkar po byang sems kyis gang ba/ dhū ti la brten pa'i lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus su a yig dmar po me'i rang bzhin mgo gyen du blta ba/ de'i phyi nang skor gyi 'dab ma brgyad la/ a ka tsa ṭa ta pa sha ya/ phyi skor gyi 'dab ma rnams ā di phrag gnyis dang*/ kā di phrag gcig la kṣa yaṃ yas spras pa/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad pa'i lte ba la hūm̐ nag po mgo thur du bstan pa 'dab ma phyogs bzhir/ bhrūṃ aṃ dzrīṃ khaṃ/ mtshams bzhir māṃ lāṃ pāṃ tāṃ/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa'i lte bar/ oṃ dmar po mgo gyen du blta ba/ 'dab ma la ā di phrag gcig /spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte bar haṃ dkar po mgo thur du blta ba/ 'dab ma rnams la ā di phrag gnyis kyis bskor bar bsam/ 'og rlung 'then pa'i rlung gis gtum mo'i me sbar/ g.yas ro ma'i me dang 'grogs te gyen du cher 'bar snying ga dang mgrin pa'i 'khor lo bsregs/ spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pas haṃ las dkar cha'i rgyun bab/ g.yon rkyang ma'i byang sems dang bsdongs nas rim gyis bab/ mgrin pa dang snying ga'i 'khor lo rnams kyang sngar bas gsal bar gsos/ thig le thigs pa gcig lte ba'i a la phog pas a las me'i zer rtse mo rno zhing reg bya tsha ba phra la myur ba dhū tir song bas snying ga'i hūm̐ dang mgrin pa'i āḥbacom/ spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pas/ haṃ las byang sems kyi dwangs ma shin tu phra ba'i rgyun dhū tir zag pas snying ga'i hūm̐ dang mgrin pa'i āḥgasos/

de'i nus pas lte ba'i me cher 'bar/ haṃ las byang sems 'dzag cing 'bar ba dang 'dzag pa dhū tir thim pas/ 'bar ba'i nus pas lus drod kyis gang zhing nad gdon sdig sgrib dang rtog pa bsregs/ 'dzag pa'i stobs kyis dhū ti'i nang thams cad byang sems kyis gang*/ lus la bde ba skyes/ sems la ye shes skyes par bsam/ rlung kha sbyor man ngag ltar bzung*/ de ltar yun du bgyis pas bde drod 'bar zhing gsal stong gi ting nge 'dzin skye/ de ltar goms nas rang byung gi ye shes skye zhing ye shes des phyi rol gyi snod bcud thams cad la rgyas btab nas bsgoms pas bskyed rdzogs kyi mtshan 'dzin sbyangs nas snang stong zung 'jug gi ting 'dzin skye zhing chos kyi sku myur du mngon par byed pa'i lam zab mo'o// de ltar bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug ni mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ro// spyi don gnyis pa mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor la bcu/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor dang*/ ldang ba/ khrus/ bzlas pa/ mchod gtor/ bstod pa/ kha zas/ spyod lam/ rjes chags/ phan yon rnams so// dang po nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang nyid lhan skyes stong pa'i ngang du nyal ba dang*/ zhu bde lhan skyes bde ba'i ngang du nyal ba'o// dang po stong pa'i ngang du nyal ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad la phog pas srung 'khor la thim/ de dur khrod sogs la/ de bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho la/ de pad sdong*/ de gzhal yas khang*/ de gdan 'khor dang bcas par/ de gtso bo yab yum brgyad la/ de gtso bo'i yum la/ de yab la/ yab thugs ka'i sa bon hrīḥl/ hrīḥyig nam mkhar 'ja' yal ba ltar mi dmigs pa'i stong gsal chen po'i ngang du seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis nyal bar bya'o// gnyis pa bde ba'i ngang du nyal ba ni/ gzhal yas khang dang gdan rnams mi bsdu bar phyogs mtshams kyi gtso bo brgyad gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim/

bdag nyid gtso bo yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i rjes chags bde ba chen po'i mes yab yum ltem gyis zhu nas byang sems thig le 'od 'bar bar gyur par bsam pa'i ngang du bde bar nyal lo// des ni gnas skabs su tha mal pa'i gnyid kyis mi brdzi zhing mthar 'chi ba sbyong bar byed do// gnyis pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ stong pa'i ngang las dang*/ bde ba'i ngang las so/ dang po stong pa'i ngang las ldang na/ gnyid sad ma thag hrīḥzhes brjod pas rang gi shes pa 'od gsal ba gtso bo yab yum du lam gyis gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas hrīḥ'aphros shing ngag tu brjod pas/ rten brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor snod bcud dang bcas pa skad cig mar rten brten pa'i tshul tu phrin las la 'jug pa'i yul du rang rang gzugs sku gsal bar ldang ngo*// gnyis pa bde ba'i ngang du ldang ba ni/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas skyod byed kyi mkha' 'gro lnga byon nas brdas bskul bas/ 'bras bu'i rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs pa'i tshul gyis langs la/ gtso bo yab yum gsal btab pa'i thugs ka'i hrīḥ'i 'od kyis rten dang brten par bcas pa sngar ltar rdzogs par ldang bar bya'o// de gnyis gang byas kyang gnas skabs tha mal pa'i g.yeng bas mi brdzi zhing mthar thug skye ba sbyong bar byed do// gsum pa khrus kyi rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis rigs lnga sogs dbang lha thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ mchod cing bstod nas/ gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lngas bum pa bdud rtsis gang bar bsnams nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes rang gi spyi bo nas blug cing khrus bgyis pas phyi nang gi dri ma thams cad dag /ye shes kyi bdud rtsis lus mer gyis gang bar bsam zhing dri bzang gi chus khrus bya/ mthar dbang lha rang gnas su gshegs pa'am rang la bsdu'o// des ni gnas skabs su ting nge 'dzin gyi grogs su 'gyur zhing mthar thug nyes ltung thams cad dag par 'gyur ro// bzhi pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/

sngar ltar rten dang brten pa bcas gsal btab cing*/ bdag nyid gtso bo yab kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dbus su hrīḥdamar po'i mthar sngags gang bzla bas bskor ba/ g.yas su 'ur sgra dang bcas myur du 'khor ba las/ de 'dra ba'i sngags phreng gnyis pa 'od zer gyi tshul du chad/ yab kyi zhal nas thon/ yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ yum gyi thugs ka'i sa bon la 'khor/ gsum gyis dkris te drag tu 'khor zhing yang de las sngags phreng 'od bcas gnyis pa chad de yum gyi gsang ba nas thon/ yab kyi gsang ba'i sbugs su zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon sngags bcas la thim te de ltar mgal me bskor ba ltar rgyun mi chad pa'i sngags kyi rang sgra dang bcas 'khor bar gyur par bsam pa ni/ bdag nyid gtso bo yab yum la ste/ phyogs mtshams kyi gtso bo yab yum dgu la'ang rang gi sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyis bskor te/ 'phro 'du ni bdag nyid gtso bo yab yum ltar rigs bsgres gsal gdab bo// yang skabs su/ sngags kyi 'od zer phyogs thams cad du 'phros pas phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba gsum dang*| sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs gnyis med ye shes kyi brtan g.yo'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bkug nas rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon la bstim pa skabs skabs su bya zhing yun gong ltar du bya'o// sngags ni spyi dril ring thung gnyis kyang mos na bya zhing*/ yang na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbadzra gu ru padma badzra de wa ḍā ki nī sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ zhes pa dang*/ yang na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru de wa ḍā ki e waṃ hrīḥm swā hā/ zhes pa rnams gang mos bya'o// de ltar sngags gang byed kyang ting nge 'dzin ma yeng zhing gzhan tshig gis bar ma chod par sngags kyi sel spangs la bzla'o// grangs ni/ spyi dril chen po yin na khri/ chung ba la 'bum/ yang na sngags 'og ma gnyis/ gtso bo la 'bru gsum/ gtso bo gzhan brgyad la khri phrag re re/

de ltar grangs tshad bshad kyang phal cher drod rtags dang bstun no// grangs tshad ni dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba dang phrin las rnams la 'jug pa'i dbang du byas/ byang chub bsgrub pa la ni tshad bzung med de ji srid kyi bar ro// sngags bzla ba'i tshe ha cang ring na dbugs kyis mi 'khyol/ thung na tshe la gzan cing kha dog kyang mi gsal/ drag cing rtsub na khams la gzan cing mi ma yin la la brgyal zhing rengs/ zhan na sngags kyi ngar mi thon/ dal na grangs nyung*/ brel na sgros mi thon pas ran cing tshod zin par bzla'o// yang na gtso bo dgu so so'i sngags bzla bar 'dod na dgongs 'dus kyi sgrub dkyil dang 'dzab dgongs rnams su blta bar bya'o// des ni gnas skabs su thun mong gi dngos grub tshegs med par thob cing mthar thug lhas rjes su 'dzin cing phyir mi ldog pa'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ro// lnga pa mchod pa dang sman raka gtor ma'i rim pa dang*/ drug pa bstod pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ dgongs 'dus kyi sgrub gzhung gzhan ltar rnal 'byor pa'i blo tshod dang bstun nas bya'o// de'i mchod gtor gyi gnas skabs su lha dgyes shing bar chad mi 'byung*/ mthar thug tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing ltung ba dag par 'gyur ro// bstod pa ni gnas skabs su kun gyis bkur zhing phrin las gang brtsams dmigs su chud la/ mthar thug mtshan dpe phun sum tshogs pa thob par 'gyur ro// bdun pa/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ rgyas pa kha zas kyi rnal 'byor du blta zhing 'dir yang bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i lag g.yas dgang gzar dang g.yon blugs gzar/ kha thab khung du bsam/ lte ba'i gtum mo'i mes lus thams cad gang ba'i dbus su padma badzra sogs gtso bo yab yum dgu gsal btab/ bza' btung oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥs bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te/ lha la sreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas kyi tshul du phul bar dmigs te chags zhen med par longs spyod/

lhag ma yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la/ oṃ utstshiṣṭa ba liṃ bhakṣa sī swā hā/ zhes se gol gyi sgra dang bcas sbyin no// des ni gnas skabs yongs su dag pa dang*/ mthar thug lha dgyes pa bskangs nas dngos grub rnam pa gnyis 'grub par 'gyur ro// brgyad pa/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ dus rtag tu phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang dang nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad rtsa ba gsum gyi lhar mos shing*/ de rnams kyang 'od dang 'od zer gyis kun tu khyab pa snang la rang bzhin med par blta zhing*/ bdag nyid padma badzra rtsal gyi nga rgyal dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas/ dbang po rnams yul la 'jug pa'i tshe lha la lhas mchod pa dang*/ lha dang lha mo snyoms 'jug 'dod yon gyi bde bar mchod pa dang*/ yul kun rtog pas bslad pa'i chags zhen med par thams cad kyang gzugs snang lha dang lha mo/ grag pa sngags kyi sgra/ 'gyu dran ting nge 'dzin/ bya ba thams cad gzhan don/ las thams cad kyang sgyu ma lta bu ngo bo ma grub par blta zhing 'dod dgur bsgyur ro// des ni gnas skabs su kun spyod thams cad lam du 'gyur ba dang*/ mthar thug rgyal ba'i dgongs spyod phrin las thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro// dgu pa/ rjes chags kyi rnal 'byor ni/ khyad par ba dang thun mong ba gnyis las/ dang po khyad par ba ni/ rtsa rlung rdo rje'i dra mig lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i nang du rtogs par bya zhing*/ gnyis pa thun mong ba ni/ yul dbang gis smin pa la byar rung zhing gzhan du ni nyes par 'gyur ro// rig ma mtshan ldan dbang gis smin par byas pa la ni/ bdag nyid padma badzra rig ma yum gsang ba ye shes su bskyed cing nga rgyal brten pa lha'i 'du shes/ mkha' gsang sngar bshad pa ltar byin gyis brlabs shing yab yum gnas gsum du yi ge gsum la gsal ba sngags kyi 'du shes/

thabs 'dis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod cing gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod blo chos kyi 'du shes te/ 'du shes gsum dang ldan pas snyoms par 'jug cing*/ bsrubs pa dang srub pa'i sbyor bas bde bas lus kun khyab pas na/ bde ba'i ngo bo stong par ldang zhing*/ de gnyis zung 'jug gi ngang du mnyam par bzhag go// tshul 'di ni goms par byas pa'i dbang du byas la/ gsar bus ni thog mar sbyang ba'i goms stabs dang mi ldan pas tshul 'di lta bu bgyis na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur bas sbyang ba sogs gzhung khrid du lta'o// chags sogs 'jig rten pa'i bde ba rang ga ma ni nam yang ma yin no// des ni gnas skabs su nyon mongs mi brdzi zhing*/ mthar thug lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes skye bar 'gyur ro// bcu pa phan yon ni/ gnas skabs su spro ba bskyed nas shugs la bshad pas/ mthar thug 'di lta bu lan cig nyams su blangs kyang*/ ring por mi thogs par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur na/ rgyun 'khyer du bgyis pas ni lta smos kyang ci dgos so// mthar rjes kyi bya bar/ thun mtshams rnams su bsdu rim byas te slar lha'i nga rgyal gyis dge ba'i bya ba gang yin la 'jug cing*/ slar mi 'gyang bar lha gsal gdab pa ni bshad ma thag pa ltar bya zhing zhib cha rnams rdo rje slob dpon mtshan ldan gyi gsung las kyang bslab par bya'o// de ltar bla ma dgongs 'dus las rtsa gsum spyi dril gyi sgrub pa yid bzhin nor bu las cung zad bsdus te rang nyid nyams su blang ba dang gzhan la'ang phan pa'i blos zab gter 'di nyid la mchog tu 'dzin pa 'bri gung skyu ra'i gdung gi tha shal/ rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pas pho brang chen po bkra shis tshugs su mgyogs par sbyar ba sarba pra dze bhyaḥ maṅga laṃ// //
